title: ColdWatch — cold-chain IoT telemetry & alerting platform

context.constraints: Must retain 90 days of raw sensor telemetry; sub-minute alerting SLA; some customers require EU data residency.

components.name: Operator dashboard
components.responsibility: Real-time fleet map, alert triage, and reporting UI for logistics operators

components.name: Ingest gateway
components.responsibility: Terminates MQTT/HTTPS from field sensors, authenticates devices, and publishes readings

components.name: Telemetry bus
components.responsibility: Durable, partitioned stream buffering millions of sensor readings for downstream consumers

components.name: Stream processor
components.responsibility: Consumes the telemetry bus, computes rolling aggregates, and evaluates alert rules

components.name: Alert dispatcher
components.responsibility: Fans out breach alerts to SMS/email/webhook and tracks acknowledgements

components.name: Primary database
components.responsibility: Devices, customers, alert rules, acknowledgements, and 90-day rolled-up metrics

components.name: Hot cache
components.responsibility: Latest-reading-per-device and rule-evaluation state for sub-minute alerting

components.name: Cold telemetry store
components.responsibility: Raw 90-day sensor telemetry archive for audit and replay

components.name: Report exports
components.responsibility: Generated PDF/CSV compliance reports available for download

components.name: Static & report CDN
components.responsibility: Serves the dashboard bundle and cached report downloads close to operators

components.name: Public API
components.responsibility: Customer-facing REST API for device provisioning and metric queries

components.name: Payment provider
components.responsibility: Subscription billing and metered overage invoicing

infrastructure.hosting: Container platform with autoscaling for the ingest and processing tier
infrastructure.database: Managed PostgreSQL with a read replica for reporting
infrastructure.cache: Managed Redis for hot state and rule evaluation
infrastructure.storage: S3-compatible object storage for raw telemetry and report exports
infrastructure.cicd: GitHub Actions pipeline with staging and production environments
rationale: Spiky ingest at large scale needs a partitioned durable bus (Kafka) so a sensor storm cannot drop readings.
Sub-minute alerting SLA demands an in-memory hot cache for latest-per-device state.
90-day raw retention is cheapest on object storage, keeping the relational DB to rolled-up metrics.
EU data-residency constraint favours providers with an EU region for the datastore and object store.

summary: ColdWatch ingests high-volume cold-chain sensor telemetry, evaluates breach rules in near-real-time, dispatches alerts, and retains 90 days of raw readings for audit — a large, spiky, growth-budget IoT workload spanning ingest, streaming, relational, cache, object storage, and CDN roles.
